Vodka yearns for the Japanese Derby, while 
Daiwa Scarlet charges full steam ahead 
toward the Triple Tiara.

Provoked into action, Vodka decided to run 
in the Tulip Sho. Is it destiny for rivals 
aiming for different paths to clash in an 
unexpected place?

Until the day of the race, they spent day 
after noisy day together, where serious 
debates often descended into nothing more 
than trading insults.
